description: Implementation of the National Media Project- ‘Healthy Food - Happy Life’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2025-08-11 to implement the ‘Healthy Food - Happy Life’ Project by the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation in the year 2025, aiming to disseminate a food safety model for a healthy life, using the funds from the Clean Sri Lanka Programme. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to further implement the National Media Project- ‘Healthy Food - Happy Life’, which aims to ensure nutrition, disease prevention, mental well-being and nutritional security through clean food consumption from the early stages of child development to adulthood, by securing an amount of Rs.600 million from the provisions allocated under the ‘Clean Sri Lanka’ programme by the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation in the years 2026, 2027 and 2028.
